license: Free / open; same CVR reuse terms
catalog_basis: Observed from real open-access responses: raw/api/regnskab_offentliggoerelse_sample.json (CVR 25313763) and raw/api/regnskab_maersk_latest.json (CVR 22756214). Open, no authentication (live-verified HTTP 200). This source returns FILING METADATA and document URLs; the actual figures live inside the linked XBRL documents (see source cvr_regnskab_xbrl).

fields.meaning: Elasticsearch document id of the published filing (URN). Stable per filing; use as the filing primary key / dedupe key.
fields.limitations: Index name (_index) changes over time (e.g. indberetninger-20230623); rely on _id, not _index.
fields.analysis_notes: Filing-level primary key. Join to companies via cvrNummer.

fields.meaning: CVR number of the company the filing belongs to. Join key to the cvr-permanent virksomhed index.
fields.limitations: Numeric; format as 8-digit string for joins.
fields.analysis_notes: Primary join key to base register and XBRL facts.

fields.meaning: Erhvervsstyrelsen case/reference number for the filing.
Legacy registration number; null in observed records.
fields.analysis_notes: Ignore unless populated; cvrNummer is the identifier.

fields.meaning: Start date of the accounting period the report covers.
fields.analysis_notes: Defines the financial period; pair with slutDato.

fields.meaning: End date of the accounting period the report covers.
fields.limitations: ISO date. Interim filings have non-12-month spans (e.g. Q1).
fields.analysis_notes: Use end date to order filings and label the financial year.

fields.meaning: Approval block for the accounts; null in the observed Maersk record.
fields.limitations: Null in observed sample; structure not confirmed.

fields.meaning: Type of publication (e.g. 'regnskab' for an accounts publication).
fields.limitations: Only 'regnskab' observed; other types may exist.
fields.analysis_notes: Filter to accounts publications for financial ingest.

fields.meaning: Whether the filing is a correction/re-publication (reversal) of a prior one.
fields.analysis_notes: If true, supersedes an earlier filing for the same period.
Sort desc to find the latest filing per company (used in the Maersk query).

fields.meaning: Last-updated timestamp of the filing record. Use as the high-water mark for incremental sync.
fields.analysis_notes: Filter/range on sidstOpdateret for incremental crawls of the whole index.

fields.meaning: When Erhvervsstyrelsen loaded the filing into the distribution system (can differ greatly from publication, e.g. bulk digitisation in 2018 of a 2009 filing).
fields.limitations: Not the publication date; do not use for financial-year ordering.

fields.meaning: Array of attached documents. Each has dokumentType (AARSRAPPORT, DELAARSRAPPORT, DELAARSRAPPORT_ESEF, ESEF_EXTENSION, ...), dokumentMimeType, and a direct dokumentUrl on regnskaber.virk.dk.
fields.limitations: Modern filings carry XBRL/iXBRL (application/xml, application/xhtml+xml); pre-digital ones are image/tiff or application/pdf. Documents are served GZIP-compressed even when Content-Type is text/xml — decompress on download.
fields.analysis_notes: Prefer application/xml or application/xhtml+xml for machine-readable figures; pick the primary AARSRAPPORT/DELAARSRAPPORT (not the ESEF extension zip) for DCCA-taxonomy parsing. See cvr_regnskab_xbrl.
